summary: Tested Layout Configurator bug fixes for sauna module. All 7 reported features/bugs verified as FIXED: 1) Grid selector has 1cm option, 2) Drawing line over rectangle does NOT move the rectangle (bug fixed), 3) Properties panel has INPUT fields for width/height of rectangles, 4) Properties panel has INPUT field for line length, 5) Dimensions displayed on canvas, 6) 'Размеры' button toggles dimension display, 7) Manual dimension input works correctly.

PASS: Properties panel (lines 2074-2110) - INPUT field for Длина (length) for lines

context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout Configurator bug fixes verified. Path: Login -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки tab. Drawing tools: Arrow (select), Square (rectangle), Line (wall). Grid selector in toolbar. Properties panel on right side shows dimension inputs when shape is selected.

grid_1cm_option.details: Grid selector dropdown contains '1 см' option. Selecting it shows finer grid on canvas.

rectangle_drawing.details: Rectangle tool works correctly. Toast shows 'Прямоугольник: X × Y см' after drawing.

line_over_rectangle_no_push.details: BUG FIXED: Drawing a line over existing rectangle does NOT move/push the rectangle. Objects made non-interactive during drawing via handleCanvasMouseDown.

rectangle_dimension_inputs.details: Properties panel shows INPUT fields for 'Ширина' (width) and 'Высота' (height) when rectangle is selected. Values in cm.

line_length_input.details: Properties panel shows INPUT field for 'Длина' (length) when line is selected. Value in cm.

dimensions_on_canvas.details: Dimension labels (e.g., '119 см', '89 см') displayed directly on canvas above/beside shapes.

dimensions_toggle_button.details: 'Размеры' button in toolbar toggles dimension label visibility on canvas.

manual_dimension_input.details: Changing values in width/height/length INPUT fields updates the shape size on canvas.
